FAQ

Questions, answered.

Is the convenience fee taken out of my menu price?

No. The per-order convenience fee is added on the customer’s total. You set your menu prices; parents see the fee at checkout.

What does the onboarding fee cover?

Your branded vendor portal, Stripe connect setup path, unlimited events, QR codes, dashboards, and print/CSV tools — with $0 monthly after that.

Do I have to sell desserts?

No. Any product you can fulfill works — treats, kits, merch, meal deals. If you can deliver it at an event or pickup, ScoopPass can pre-sell it.

How does the money get to me?

Payments deposit directly into your connected Stripe account. ScoopPass never holds your money. Standard Stripe payout timing applies.

Is the founding rate really locked for life?

Yes. Sign up as a founding vendor before 2027 and your $1.00 per-order convenience fee stays locked for as long as you use ScoopPass.
